what_the_model_does: A 6x6 articulated dump truck controlled via Control+ motors. Features an articulated steering joint, a 3-speed automatic gearbox, 6-wheel drive with pendular rear suspension, and a heavy-duty tipping bed driven by linear actuators.

systems.name: Front and rear articulated chassis
systems.real_machine: The heavy-duty front cab frame and rear payload frame connected by an articulated pivot joint.
systems.purpose: Provides a rigid structural spine for the cab, motors, gearbox, drive shafts, axles, and dump body.
systems.why_built_first: Serves as the foundation that carries the electronics, motors, and suspension.

parts.beam.*: Structural frame member holding axles, pins, and motors.
parts.pin-.*: Friction or frictionless connector securing structural frame joints.
parts.conn.*: Connector joint holding axles and frame beams together.
parts.tile.*: Decorative trim or smooth surface tile.

systems.name: 6x6 Drivetrain and 3-speed gearbox
systems.real_machine: The engine, automatic transmission, transfer case, drive shafts, differentials, and 6-wheel drive system.
systems.purpose: Transfers motor drive through a 3-speed transmission to all six wheels with pendular rear axle suspension.
systems.why_built_first: Gearbox and motors must be enclosed within the central chassis during early build steps.

parts.gear.*: Transmission and drive gear passing torque from motors to drive shafts.
parts.axle.*: Drive shaft transferring rotational power along the vehicle.
parts.bush.*: Spacer securing gears and axles along shafts.
parts.tyre.*: Rubber tire providing traction on all six wheels.

systems.name: Articulated steering mechanism
systems.real_machine: Hydraulic steering cylinders that pivot the front cab relative to the rear trailer.
systems.purpose: Pivots the front chassis section relative to the rear chassis section to steer the vehicle.
systems.why_built_first: Joins the front and rear frame sections together at the central articulated joint.

parts.part-.*: Steering linkage or structural component in the articulated joint.

systems.name: Payload dump body and linear actuators
systems.real_machine: The rear tipping dump bed and hydraulic hoist rams.
systems.purpose: Lifts and dumps heavy cargo from the rear bed using motor-driven linear actuators.
systems.why_built_first: Mounted on top of the rear frame after the drivetrain and suspension are assembled.

parts.panel.*: Side or floor panel of the heavy-duty dump bed.
